selector.champion: IBD-associated neutrophilic dermatosis with ulcerative colitis
selector.rationale: The patient's history of diverticulosis and colonic polyps, combined with the presence of moderate inflammation, edema, erosions, and pseudopolyps in the sigmoid colon, supports the diagnosis of IBD-associated neutrophilic dermatosis with ulcerative colitis. The facial crusted plaques, discrete pustules, and painful subcutaneous nodules are also consistent with this diagnosis.
